user.title: Connect SMS.to
user.description: API key from sms.to → Developers → API Keys. It's checked by reading your balance; no SMS is sent.

data_description.sender_id: Up to 11 letters/digits, or a phone number.

init.description:
Delivery-report webhook URL (paste it in SMS.to if you want reports for messages sent outside HA too):
{webhook_url}

data_description.delivery_reports: Adds this integration's webhook as callback_url on every message. Needs an external URL (or Nabu Casa).
data_description.webhook_secret: If set in SMS.to, paste it here: unsigned callbacks will be rejected.
